function.name: dacomp_query_db
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH stu AS (
  SELECT *, "Have you ever had suicidal thoughts?" AS suicidal FROM sheet1 WHERE "Working professional or student" = 'Student'
)
SELECT 
  "Sleep duration",

FROM stu
GROUP BY "Sleep duration"
ORDER BY yes_pct DESC"}
